One normalisation policy governs both image passes. No opaque RGBA ships un-collapsed.
THIS ROW SPANS TWO WORK PACKAGES BY CONSTRUCTION AND CANNOT CLOSE INSIDE WP-03. Recorded by vc 2026-09-09 18:12Z, WHILE cc IS BUILDING C2, so it is known in advance rather than discovered at grading. design.md:1177 names the two passes and they do not live together: `normalise_image` (showreel:271) is **INIT ONLY** and writes 2560px masters, and `data_uri` (showreel:417) is **BUILD**. Init is WP-04. So a row that says "governs BOTH image passes" has half its population in a work package WP-03 does not touch, and grading it when C2 lands would be AC-3.5's error a third time -- verifying the built half thoroughly and never asking where the other one lives. THE ROW IS NOT SPLIT AND MUST NOT BE. The whole property is that ONE policy governs both; two rows, one per pass, would permit exactly the divergence the row exists to forbid, and this contract's rule is that a criterion pins properties rather than enumerations. WHAT LANDS WHEN IS THEREFORE: the POLICY itself is one module and lands inside showreel with C2 in WP-03, where it can be read and red-proved; its APPLICATION at the second site lands with init in WP-04; and the artifact-level half -- no opaque RGBA ships un-collapsed -- needs a built artifact and a real reel, so it is later still. The asymmetry being retired is concrete and is what the row is protecting against: `normalise_image` carries an alpha-collapse heuristic at showreel:283-285 demoting a fully-opaque RGBA to RGB/JPEG, `data_uri` has no equivalent, and its PNG branch at showreel:426 is the DEFAULT path for hand-placed brand marks -- so under the reference a fully-opaque RGBA PNG ships full-size where init would have made it a JPEG. DISCHARGED AT WP-04, NOT AT C2.

THE ARTIFACT-LEVEL CLAUSE IS A TAUTOLOGY ON 45h, AND THAT IS THE THIRD KIND OF ZERO RATHER THAN THE CENSUS IT LOOKS LIKE. Measured 2026-09-09 18:59Z by TWO nodes with TWO instruments, neither redundant. cc (5853f33) read the ALPHA VALUES of every raster asset: both brand PNGs genuinely transparent, so the collapse does not fire on them in either implementation, and the six art files plus the one location file carry no alpha at all. vc verified with a DIFFERENT instrument -- the DECLARED colour type at the PNG IHDR's byte 25 -- with the members printed rather than counted, because a count whose members you cannot see is a claim you cannot check. NINE raster assets: six `assets/art/*.jpg` which cannot carry alpha BY FORMAT; one `assets/location/forbiddenplanet-01.png` at colour type 2, RGB, NO ALPHA CHANNEL; and two `assets/brand/*.png` at colour type 6, RGBA, alpha channel PRESENT.
THE TWO INSTRUMENTS COMPOSE AND NEITHER COULD HAVE DONE THE OTHER'S HALF. The header settles SEVEN of nine STRUCTURALLY and without any pixel scan -- a file with no alpha channel cannot be an opaque RGBA, full stop -- and cc's scan settles the remaining two, which no header can answer, since colour type 6 says an alpha channel EXISTS and says nothing about whether it is used. This is the rule about two nodes agreeing on an instrument wasting one of them, applied deliberately for once rather than after the fact.
SO THE OPAQUE-RGBA POPULATION ON 45h IS EMPTY, FOR TWO DIFFERENT REASONS, AND THE CLAUSE "no opaque RGBA ships un-collapsed" IS TRIVIALLY TRUE ON THIS REEL. A build over 45h satisfies that sentence perfectly while exercising the mechanism ZERO times. **That is a tautology -- the branch is never reached -- and it passes a has-it-fired check, because the detector DOES fire, in cc's three synthetic tests.** Reachability is a property of the RUN, and on this run the branch is unreachable.
WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO: IT DOES NOT WEAKEN THE ROW OR THE RULING. One policy governing both passes is still the whole property; cc's ruling stands and its reasoning never leaned on the 45h instance; and the code IS covered -- three synthetic tests drive the arm, one of them carrying the insight in its own name, `one_transparent_pixel_in_a_million_stops_the_demotion`. **The code is covered while the REEL is not, and those are different facts.** What can no longer be claimed is that 45h demonstrates anything about this arm.
DISCHARGE CONDITION UNCHANGED, WITH ONE THING ADDED. Still WP-04, because `normalise_image` is init-only. AND the artifact-level half must be graded on a CONSTRUCTED reel carrying a genuinely opaque RGBA, or explicitly stated as ungradeable on 45h -- **a green from 45h is not evidence for this arm**, exactly as it is not evidence for the bug embed or for the sort ordering. Three arms now, one shape.
